measured: 2026-11-02 (see git history), descriptive — first run of the USB camera source after PR #333
command: canli_mac --source "dshow:Insta360 X5" --device-fps 30 --match-id 990771 --home-team 30798 --away-team 30799 --camera static --segment-seconds 30 --fresh --database-url sqlite:///<proje>/demo.db (no calibration; camera pointed at a room, not a pitch)

camera.model: Insta360 X5 in USB webcam mode
camera.observed: requesting 1920x1080 still delivered 2880x1440 (mode is chosen on the camera, not by the command); first seconds emit MJPEG 'EOI missing' warnings, then clean frames; ~2 s start-up

result.segmenting: ok — 30 s H.264 segments of 2880x1440 @ 30 fps, 23–29 MB each, four written in 2 minutes
result.tracking: no frames written: without --calibration the pipeline falls back to per-frame automatic calibration, which looks for pitch structures in the image; a room has none, so every frame is skipped ('çapa bulunamadı, inlier %26'). This is the intended behaviour: positions are never invented without a pitch.
result.panel: match 990771 therefore shows nothing; the panel view was checked with the earlier rehearsal 990731 instead (telestration card: 'seg_0009 · 44.5' · çizilen kare %77 · akış bitti · atlanan 6 segment', video renders)
result.disk: segments deleted after the run (84 MB)

verified: USB camera → ffmpeg dshow → segments → track_live start → detector on GPU → DB preflight
not_verified: frame writing, telestration and panel update from a USB camera — needs the camera on a real pitch with a calibration (or at least visible markings for the automatic anchor)
panel_findings_for_product_session: decisions/live minute slider is min=50 max=95; all live rehearsals so far are at minute 10–45, so 'Saha Overlay' cannot reach their frames from the slider. In live mode the minute should follow the tracking status (processed_minute) instead of the slider.
/tracking/live/<id>/telestration answers 401 without a session cookie; the card then shows 'Telestrasyon okunamadı — yeniden denenecek' with no hint that a login is needed.
